The '''''Lupo''''' was a [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] that served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Lupo'' was part of a group of three ''Dreadnaught''-class cruisers, along with the ''[[Nicodemus]]'' and the ''[[Topol]]'', that were fitted with explosives in order to [[Ramship|ram]] and destroy the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']] during the [[Battle of Nocto]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
